_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "school" TEXT NOT NULL, "login" TEXT NOT NULL, "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_metadata" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "student_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "database_snapshot_id" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_time" INTEGER NULL, "last_end_date" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "students" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "users_edu_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "surname" TEXT NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "pin" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teachers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "login" TEXT NOT NULL, "users_edu_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "surname" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "pin" TEXT NULL, "user_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subjects" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subjects_edu_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "abbr" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "groups_edu_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "attr" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "terms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "patrons_id" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "rooms_id" INTEGER NULL, "event_types_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "substitution" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attr" INTEGER NOT NULL, "terms_id" INTEGER NULL, "lesson_groups_id" INTEGER NULL, "locked" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_types" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subjects_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "teaching_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "substitution" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_type_teachers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "teachers_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_types_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_type_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_types_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_type_terms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "terms_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_types_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_subjects" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "events_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "add_time" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_issues" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "events_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_types_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "issues_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "events1_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "events2_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_type_schedules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "event_types_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "schedules_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lesson_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "selected" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lessons" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lesson_groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lesson_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "marks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_scales_id" INTEGER NULL, "pupil_users_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "teacher_users_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_value" REAL NULL, "comments" TEXT NULL, "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, "get_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "add_time" INTEGER NULL, "modified" INTEGER NOT NULL, "events_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mark_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "parent_type" INTEGER NULL, "mark_group_groups_id" INTEGER NULL, "is_pattern" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_type_terms_id" INTEGER NULL, "mark_kinds_id" INTEGER NULL, "abbreviation" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "mark_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_format" TEXT NULL, "mark_division_groups_id" INTEGER NULL, "mark_scale_groups_id" INTEGER NULL, "visibility" INTEGER NOT NULL, "css_style" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_value_range_min" REAL NULL, "mark_value_range_max" REAL NULL, "precision" REAL NULL, "add_by_users_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mark_kinds" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "abbreviation" TEXT NOT NULL, "subjects_id" INTEGER NULL, "public" INTEGER NOT NULL, "add_by_users_id" INTEGER NULL, "default_mark_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "default_mark_scale_groups_id" INTEGER NULL, "default_mark_division_groups_id" INTEGER NULL, "default_weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "css_style" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mark_scale_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "public" INTEGER NOT NULL, "add_by_users_id" INTEGER NULL, "mark_types" TEXT NULL, "mark_scale_group_edu_id" INTEGER NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mark_scales" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_scale_groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "abbreviation" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mark_value" REAL NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "classified" INTEGER NOT NULL, "no_count_to_average" INTEGER NOT NULL, "css_style" TEXT NULL, "mark_scale_edu_id" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mark_division_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_scale_groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "public" INTEGER NOT NULL, "range_min" REAL NULL, "range_max" REAL NULL, "precision" REAL NULL, "add_by_users_id" INTEGER NULL, "mark_division_group_edu_id" INTEGER NULL, "range_max_to_display" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mark_group_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_division_groups_id" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "is_pattern" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mark_group_issues" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mark_groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "issues_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendances" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "events_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "students_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "types_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_types" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "abbr" TEXT NOT NULL, "style" TEXT NULL, "count_as" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "messages" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "send_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sender_users_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recipient_users_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "read_time" INTEGER NULL, "hide" INTEGER NOT NULL, "files" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_reprimands" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "students_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "teachers_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kinds_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "get_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "add_time" INTEGER NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "student_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "students_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "strike_off_time" INTEGER NULL, "strike_off_reason" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_educators" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "teachers_educator_id" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_terms" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "terms_id" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "permission_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "permission_groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "additional_description" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "permissions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "permission_groups_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "users_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "edu_id" INTEGER NULL, "quantitative_limit" INTEGER NULL, "grant_time" INTEGER NULL, "expire_time" INTEGER NULL, "source" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "translation_cache_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "translated_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "place" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "recurrence_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "recurrence_start_date" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_end_date" INTEGER NULL, "recurrence_weekdays" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_event_occurrences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "custom_event_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_events (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ignored_attendances" ("attendance_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ignored_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("attendance_id"));
